quote: Where the signal is a steady red with a green turn arrow: Except as otherwise provided in paragraph (b) [NRS-484B-307-9b], vehicular traffic facing the signal may enter the intersection only to make the movement indicated by the green turn arrow, but must yield the right-of-way to pedestrians lawfully within an adjacent crosswalk and to other traffic lawfully using the intersection. Drivers turning in the direction of the arrow are thereby advised that so long as the turn arrow is illuminated, oncoming or opposing traffic simultaneously faces a steady red signal.

activation.condition: Motor vehicle faces a steady red with illuminated green turn arrow at an intersection.

obligation.description: Enter only for the indicated arrow movement and yield to lawfully present adjacent-crosswalk pedestrians and lawfully using intersection traffic.

exceptions.trigger: Paragraph (b) is cited, with eligible operator classes specified in NRS 484B.307(9)(b); frozen motor_vehicle_driver does not establish eligibility.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: No exception-present motor vehicle scenario inferred.
exceptions.source_clause: Except as otherwise provided in paragraph (b) [NRS-484B-307-9b]

timing.description: Arrow permission while illuminated; movement and yielding at intersection entry and transit.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: pedestrians lawfully within an adjacent crosswalk
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original crosswalk, pedestrian position and lawful status require independent source review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: other traffic lawfully using the intersection
judgment_calls_needed.note: Other-vehicle physical presence is insufficient to establish lawful use.
Relative motion and precedence require original sources; no numerical legal cutoff is inferred.
